Synopsis:
Investors are heading into a high-stakes Fed meeting with genuine uncertainty over whether Chair Kevin Warsh will hike rates from the current 3.50-3.75% range. Markets are pricing ~70% odds of a 25bps hike. Persistent inflation (core PCE at 3.3%), strong jobs data, and hawkish Warsh signaling are driving hike expectations. The S&P 500 is 2.7% off all-time highs, the 10-year yield is pressing toward 5%, and oil has spiked above $100/bbl on US-Iran tensions — creating a multi-front risk environment. Investors are watching not just the hike decision but whether it signals a full tightening cycle.
